summary: Banco Multiva, as Issuer Trustee, announced final results of an exchange offer and consent solicitation for its 11.000% Senior Secured Notes due 2031 (US$303M outstanding), offering Fixed Rate Senior Secured Notes due 2032. Eligible holders tendered US$301,994,340 (99.67%) by the Early Tender Deadline, accepted and exchanged on Early Settlement Date. No additional tenders after deadline; no Final Settlement. Supplemental Indenture executed August 4, 2026, amending the indenture. Exchange Agent: D.F. King. This liability management exercise extends maturities, reducing near-term refinancing risk.
